memory_candidates.content: When 15+ near-identical markdown insertions are needed across agent-prompt files that share a common anchor string (e.g. the IMPORTANT paragraph immediately preceding a fixed heading), grep the anchor+heading pair across all targets first to confirm structural uniformity before editing, then apply the identical Edit old_string/new_string pair per file. This caught that lean-implementation-agent.md/general-implementation-agent.md/planner-agent.md use a different skeleton (no Agent Metadata heading) and were correctly excluded from the target set at planning time.

git-commit-scoped.sh's automatic ephemeral-runtime-file exclusion (:(exclude) entries for .lock/, .orchestrator-loop-guard, etc.) does not suppress git's ignored-file warning/failure when the positive pathspec is the task directory itself (specs/{NNN}_{SLUG}/) as a directory glob -- git still emits 'The following paths are ignored... hint: Use -f' and the wrapping `if ! git add` check treats that as a failure, aborting before any commit. Workaround: stage the task directory's known subdirectories/files explicitly (plans/, progress/, reports/, summaries/, .return-meta.json) instead of the trailing-slash directory glob, which stages cleanly without touching gitignored paths.

next_steps: Optionally run a headless deploy to sync agent-system/extensions/** into .claude/ so the new references are live for the next dispatch.
